_comment: 音声マニフェスト。file の場所に mp3 を置けば自動で使われます(無いときは内蔵の簡易シンセ音)。prompt は tools/elevenlabs/generate_audio.py が ElevenLabs に送る英語プロンプト。

title.prompt: Dark synthwave title theme for an esports arena game. Pulsing analog bass, glossy neon pads, gated drums, confident and cool, 118 BPM, minor key, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

intro.prompt: Cinematic electronic trailer underscore. Rising synth swells, deep sub hits, ticking arpeggios building anticipation, night city in the sky, 92 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

lobby.prompt: Chill but energetic lobby music for a competitive online game. Lo-fi house groove, warm electric piano chords, punchy kick, neon night vibe, 110 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

match.prompt: High-energy competitive match music. Driving electro-house with heavy sidechained bass, sharp synth stabs, breakbeat fills, ink-splashing chaos, 128 BPM, minor key, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

overdrive.prompt: Final 20 seconds overdrive music. Faster, intense drum and bass energy, rising synth leads, alarm-like arps, maximum hype, 140 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

tag.prompt: Tense yet playful chase music for a bomb tag game. Ticking percussion, wobbling bass, quirky synth plucks, suspenseful hits, 134 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

training.prompt: Focused practice-room music. Clean minimal techno, soft pads, steady groove, light and encouraging, 104 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

result.prompt: Victorious results screen music. Bright anthemic synth chords, big drums, celebratory but stylish, 112 BPM, major key, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

ending.prompt: Reflective ending theme. Slow neon synth ballad, warm pads, gentle piano, distant city ambience, after the match, 84 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

credits.prompt: Staff roll music. Smooth retro-futuristic electro-funk, sparkling arpeggios, relaxed groove, 96 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

ui_select.prompt: Sleek futuristic UI confirm, short digital blip with a soft glow, esports menu

ui_back.prompt: Futuristic UI cancel, short descending digital blip

ui_hover.prompt: Very short subtle UI hover tick, glassy

ui_toggle.prompt: Short crisp UI toggle switch click, digital

shot.prompt: Paint blaster shot, wet pressurized ink squirt with a punchy pop, short

splat.prompt: Ink paint splat hitting a wall, wet splash, short

hit.prompt: Getting hit by a paint shot, wet thwack with a low electronic thud

hit_confirm.prompt: Hit marker confirmation sound, crisp high tick, competitive shooter

inkout.prompt: Robot bursting into a big splash of paint, wet explosion with electronic glitch tail, not violent

respawn.prompt: Respawn sound, rising digital shimmer and teleport beam

jump.prompt: Light robot jump, short pneumatic hiss with a spring

land.prompt: Small robot landing on a metal floor, soft thud

land_big.prompt: Heavy landing impact on a metal arena floor, deep boom with paint splash

flip.prompt: Gravity flip whoosh, swirling air with rising electronic sweep, world rotating

stamp.prompt: Ink stamp ground slam, massive bass drop impact with a big paint splash and shockwave

special_ready.prompt: Special ability charged, ascending synth arpeggio with power-up shimmer

bomb_throw.prompt: Throwing a glowing energy bomb, whoosh with electric crackle

bomb_boom.prompt: Gravity bomb explosion, deep reverse-swell then paint blast and warping sound

go.prompt: Match start horn, punchy synth stab with crowd-like energy

overdrive.prompt: Overdrive alarm, rising synth siren and bass hit, intense

round_end.prompt: Round end buzzer, descending synth chord

win.prompt: Victory fanfare, short triumphant synth brass and drums

lose.prompt: Defeat sting, short descending synth phrase, not sad

tag_pass.prompt: Bomb passed to another player, sharp electric zap swoosh

tag_tick.prompt: Bomb timer tick, sharp digital click

tag_boom.prompt: Cartoon-styled big bomb explosion, boom with confetti-like sparkle tail, not gory

shove.prompt: Shove push, short air blast thump

whoosh.prompt: Fast cinematic whoosh through the night sky

lobby_join.prompt: Player joined lobby notification, friendly two-tone synth chime
